subject: Quick follow-up: demo appointment — timezone clarification and new slots
messages:

To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@rivermark.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 16:10:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood demo — availability and timezone options

Hi Alex,

Thanks again for the interest—would love to show a short (25m) walkthrough of Redwood focusing on latency/cost controls for payments workloads. I pulled a few windows that should cover both NA and EU local times; pick whichever is easiest and I will send an invite in your timezone: 

• Mon Dec 19 — 10:00 AM PT / 18:00 UTC / 19:00 CET
• Mon Dec 19 — 2:00 PM PT / 22:00 UTC / 23:00 CET
• Tue Dec 20 — 09:00 AM PT / 17:00 UTC / 18:00 CET

Agenda attached (short). If none of these work, tell me your preferred CET time and I’ll match it. I’ll cc Laura (solutions) so she can join if helpful.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference

From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@rivermark.com>

Date: Sat, 19 Dec 2026 01:05:00 +0100

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@rivermark.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 19 Dec 2026 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: Missed meeting — quick note

Alex — I hopped into the call at the scheduled time but couldn’t find you. No worries — these things happen. I looked at the event and it appears the invite was created with the calendar timezone set to Pacific Time (ET/US Pacific), so it may have displayed differently in your local calendar.

If you have a moment: did your calendar show the event as 10:00 local time (CET) on your side? If so, that explains the mismatch.

If you’re available later today/tomorrow I can send a corrected invite with the explicit IANA tz (Europe/Amsterdam) so it displays correctly in Outlook/Google Calendar. Proposed CET-friendly slots:

• Mon Dec 19 — 19:00 CET (same time as original, if you want to keep it)
• Tue Dec 20 — 09:00 CET (early morning)
• Tue Dec 20 — 14:00 CET (afternoon)

I’ll keep the session short and focused on the model serving profile for transaction workloads. Apologies for the confusion — happy to jump on whichever option you prefer.

Thanks,
Rafael

On the off chance you’re still at the original time, I left the recording option open and can share notes.
From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@rivermark.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 19 Dec 2026 19:42:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Missed meeting — quick note

Hi Rafael — apologies, that was on me. I assumed the 10:00 you sent was 10:00 CET (my mistake). My calendar rendered it as 10:00 and I only realized after the hour passed.

Thanks for offering new slots — Tue Dec 20 at 14:00 CET would work best for our team. If you can send an updated invite with the timezone set to Europe/Amsterdam (or explicitly show both CET and PT times), that should avoid any confusion. Could you also include a Webex link — our security team requires recorded sessions for vendor evaluations.

Sorry again for the mix-up — looking forward to the demo.

— Alex
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@rivermark.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 19 Dec 2026 20:30:00 -0800
Subject: Updated invite + Webex (Tue Dec 20, 14:00 CET)

Thanks for confirming, Alex — no problem at all. I created a new calendar invite and explicitly set the event timezone to Europe/Amsterdam so it should appear as 14:00 CET in your calendar. The invite includes a Webex link and recording enabled per your request.

Attached: redwood-demo-updated.ics (calendar file) and demo-agenda.pdf.

Let me know if the invite shows the right time on your side and I’ll mark Laura as optional on the event. Looking forward to Tuesday.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Account Exec, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-demo-updated.ics, demo-agenda.pdf
